purpose: Advisory project coordination and evidence tracking. No scheduling, capability grant or runtime execution.

status_rules.backlog: A bounded next task is defined; no current claim.
status_rules.in_progress: An assigned owner is actively implementing the named slice.
status_rules.integration_pending: A component or offline slice exists; named integration or qualification gates remain.
status_rules.blocked: The named task cannot proceed without a concrete external prerequisite recorded in next_task.
status_rules.complete: The stated slice's acceptance criteria are evidenced; this does not promote component evidence to live gameplay.
status_rules.deferred: Explicitly outside the current finite priorities.

evidence_rules.code: Implementation exists; not proof of a passing test.
evidence_rules.test_source: Test code exists; a result needs a dated report or explicit scoped note.
evidence_rules.offline_report: Documented or agent-reported offline result, scoped to the named component.
evidence_rules.live: Only actual game observations qualify a live behavior; prior builds and human demonstrations remain distinct.
evidence_rules.path_status: existing evidence paths must resolve inside this repository; planned files belong only in planned_outputs.

coordination.claims: Coordinator reserves exact owned paths in claim_registry. Optional planned_outputs are candidate future files, not authoritative claims. External task briefs are proposed and unclaimed until explicitly assigned.
coordination.review_cadence: Update when a task starts, reports results or changes scope; review the queue manually at milestones or a weekly planning session. No recurring automation is created.
coordination.dependency_semantics: depends_on gates the next offline task; runtime_requires gates later runtime composition. Both are acyclic references. Pure offline work may proceed before runtime prerequisites finish.
